frame: docs/design/rulings-2026-10-23d.md (the daze, the sell and the rally; behind rally.enabled)

links.name: Rope Return
links.input: laying Velvet Rope across the body's coming path in the rally (LB with RB and B; revision 9 on), then no press: the send carries him across it
links.what: the rope, armed, fires her level-1 beam along itself as he crosses and knocks him back across her line (a knock-back, 20 item 2); the ping-pong across a line she drew
links.price: the trap's 12 ki and its lay (her guard down 12 ticks)
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: two hem plates set in the air, a rope of light between them
links.look: the line flares, the beam runs post to post, the body is turned back like a ball off a net
links.needs: it arms 30 ticks after it is laid, so it is laid while he is still on his way: a read, not a reaction

links.name: Banner Drop
links.input: RB with A at the body in flight (revision 9 on)
links.what: four banner staves close round the body in the air, and her payoff, the slam, drags it straight down into the ground under it from any height: a spike from anywhere, not only from above. He lands on one knee: the slam's landing only. On hard ground it glances up as a spike does
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: she takes the clasp at her throat
links.look: the staves stand round him in the air, then drive down with him; a crater under his knee
links.legal: no lines of light joining the staves into a box, no dome, no cell (e16); the kneel is the landing only, with no taunt, zoom or finisher (e12, e16); one call-out (ln06)

links.name: Mantle Wall
links.input: no press: a send toward her while she braces (the stick held toward the body with LB)
links.what: she braces her mantle as a wall and the body strikes it and rebounds back along its line: a ricochet off her braced mantle, the force the send's. The mantle stands; it never wraps, coils or grabs
links.tech: item 8 with 23d item 17's middle step: 4 ticks for a fresh kind, 6 for a kind used earlier in the rally but not as the last link, 8 for the same kind as the last, and a third of one kind is teched by itself
links.tell: she plants her heel and swings the mantle forward, rigid as a door
links.look: the hem plates lock edge to edge, a ring of force where the body meets them, and she is pushed back a step
links.needs: Narrative's rename (2026-10-25): 'guard' stays out of her lines, and the bank is her braced mantle, so no guard closes, launches or knocks back (empress-guards.md section 4 is met). Game Design may still rule the design; it works in every form
links._renamed: Narrative: Guard's Wall became Mantle Wall

sell._frame: 23d item 4: in the daze each landed medium or heavy takes the launch's hit-stop (12), a camera push and a reaction a size larger; the sell is the look, never the number

medium.head: turns with the blow, the mantle flaring and settling
medium.recover: her chin comes up as she is pulled in

heavy.head: thrown back
heavy.body: the whole mantle billows as she is driven a step back; she laughs through it
heavy.recover: a booming laugh and a royal straightening of the shoulders; she never calls her guards

send.look: launched with the mantle streaming behind like a banner, laughing

sell._legal: the body is never limp; no slow motion beyond the hit-stop, no taunt over a dazed fighter; each sold blow is one flash event at most (fx08)

legalAsks: the rope as a rally link
the banner drop's slam and kneel in the air
the mantle wall: the mantle never wraps, coils or grabs, never reads as a tail
